Internal helper: the categories of each dummy-coded predictor, for plots

Source: R/models.R
dot-jst_dummy_groups.Rd

The map jplot() needs to draw a dummy-coded variable as ONE variable (Session 360; the S359 item): each variable's categories in the order of their codes, the label each carries in the coefficient table, and the dummy column that marks it (NA for the reference). Built from the same registrations and the same label lookup the table uses (.jst_reg_value_labels(), .jst_format_value_labels()), so the plot and the table cannot label a category two ways, and after .jst_prune_absent_categories(), so a category with no case in the analysis sample is not drawn. Unlike .jst_collect_multicat_regs() it keeps a two-category variable (one dummy column): a plot of it has two categories along the axis.

Usage

.jst_dummy_groups(
  dummy_regs,
  auto_cat_regs,
  dummy_coef_names,
  lab_src,
  value_mode
)

Arguments

dummy_regs

List of jdummy registrations, or NULL.

auto_cat_regs

Named list of in-flight registrations, keyed by variable name.

dummy_coef_names

Character vector of dummy column names in the fitted model.

lab_src

Pre-conversion data frame used as the label source.

value_mode

Resolved value.id mode for the labels, as the coefficient table uses it.

Value

A named list, one element per dummy-coded variable in the model, each a list of labels (character) and dummy (character, NA for the reference), in code order. Empty when the model has no dummy-coded predictor.
